title: SkyrimNet Messageless Immersion
tagline: Immersive player thoughts for game events, status changes, and supported mods.
description:
SkyrimNet Messageless Immersion is an SKSE plugin that turns game events,
status changes, notifications, and events from supported mods into immersive
SkyrimNet player thoughts.

This Hub entry links to the complete mod download. The full mod is required
because it contains the native SKSE DLL, ESP, Papyrus scripts, configuration,
and SkyrimNet trigger definitions.

Version 0.6.12 supports both the legacy SkyrimNet trigger layout used through
beta25 RC6 and the external content-plugin layout introduced in beta25 RC7.

Download and install the latest release with your mod manager.
